name: Cadets
summary: A club program run by volunteers in local churches for primary school boys aged 9 to 14.

body.heading: What Cadets is
paragraphs: The Christian Cadet Corps is an independent youth ministry. It gives local churches a program that helps them share Christ's love with boys from their church and community.
Cadets is run by volunteers called counsellors. The program is for primary school boys aged 9 to 14.

body.heading: What happens at Cadets
paragraphs: At a club night the boys learn about God, work on badges, make crafts, play games, sing songs and make new friends. Clubs also go on camps and outings.

body.heading: What we believe
paragraphs: The basis of the Christian Cadet Corps is the Word of God (the Bible) according to the concepts expressed in the Heidelberg Catechism, the Canons of Dort and the Belgic Confession.

body.heading: The goal
paragraphs: Luke 2:52 says that "Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and men."

Based on that verse, Cadets aims to help boys grow spiritually in all areas of life: devotional, mental, physical and social. It does this by giving Christian men a structure, program and materials designed for the purpose.

body.heading: Current theme: Amazing
paragraphs: The club theme is "Amazing", based on Joshua 3:5: "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you." Through the year the boys are reminded that God is holy, that we must prepare ourselves to be in his presence, and that God has done, is doing and will do amazing things.
Leaders are encouraged to set the example: look for, find and share the amazing things God is doing.
